h1: We teach AI, and *we build with it*
meta_title: About us: Hardik Aseri and team | Artificia AI
meta_description: Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd is an AI training and automation company in Vadodara, Gujarat. Meet trainer Hardik Aseri and founder Vijay Linju Raghavan.

fields.subheading: Artificia AI is an AI training and automation company in Vadodara, Gujarat. The people who teach the classes also build the systems.

fields.heading: Who *we are*
fields.body:
Artificia Intellec Pvt Ltd is an AI company based in Vadodara. We train people to use AI on real work, and we help companies put it into their own operations.

Three lines of work, one team:

  • A live AI Masterclass for individuals, in Vadodara.
  • Corporate AI training built around each client's documents.
  • AI systems for businesses: GoHighLevel, websites, content and RAG.

items.name: Hardik Aseri
items.bio: Teaches the AI Masterclass and leads Artificia's automation projects. He has trained working professionals, business owners and college graduates.

items.name: Vijay Linju Raghavan
items.bio: Brings a background in film and photography, an economics degree from MSU Baroda, and experience founding tech and e-commerce ventures.

cards.title: AI Masterclass
cards.text: Live in Vadodara, one hour a day, for 30 or 60 days.

cards.title: Corporate AI training
cards.text: Custom programs, on-site or over Microsoft Teams.

cards.title: Services
cards.text: GoHighLevel, websites, content and RAG automation.

fields.heading: Not sure where to *start*?
fields.text: Tell us what you want to do with AI. We will point you to the right course, program or service.
